`SourceSans3-Regular.otf` is from Adobe Source Sans 3, revision
`87b37a2daaed80fcb8e8ccb0085c4d72ddade12e`, distributed under the adjacent
SIL Open Font License. It exercises OpenType CFF cubic outlines.

`SourceSansVariable-Roman.otf` is the Adobe Source Sans variable font from
the ttf-parser repository at revision `0c7291223fe9e0bc2808f0255cb991066eedd796`,
covered by the same license. It exercises the default CFF2 instance.
